P_0x000946: Pilot of Cybuster, the <Masoukishin> of Wind. Impulsive and just, a natural athlete, but hopeless with directions. A Japanese youth summoned to the Holy Kingdom of Langran in <La Gias> to avert a prophesied calamity.
P_0x000ADC: Only daughter of <DC> leader Bian Zoldark. Superhuman athleticism, reflexes, eyesight. Pretty but headstrong, weak to flattery. Loves period dramas; saving money is her hobby.
P_0x001003: Only daughter of Zeoroot Zan Zenosakis, the Langran sword master who took Masaki in; she adored him and became his stepsister. Mature for her age, with real magical talent, and Zeoroot's swordplay etched into her. A fine cook specializing in Japanese dishes learned from Masaki.
P_0x0020E3: TA Shutedonias soldier. Rank rises and falls with his exploits and blunders (never the same mistake twice). Seems a careless clown at first, but is shrewd. Raised in Troia until age ten, he speaks with a Troia accent.
P_0x00233B: Leader of a Shutedonias special ops platoon, ranked major - high for the post, as his elite unit handles vital missions. A career soldier through and through.
P_0x0025A0: UA Shutedonias officer; former attache to Langran with wide connections.
P_0x00262F: Ex-Shutedonias garrison captain, now boss of a bandit gang (claim guerrillas). Falsely suspected over his Langran-born wife, he deserted; her death drove him to banditry. Cultured, but talks rough to avoid being underestimated.
U_0x005EA9: White Tiger of the Four Gods, a <Chokijin>. Even alone, KoOhKi excels at high-speed ground combat. Blackened and serving Baral, it now rivals psychic-piloted power.
